credential: Free electronic HELP Statement of Accomplishment
rationale: The course remains actively used and was launched for an Albanian cohort in April 2026, but the official self-learning course description identifies the underlying course as published in July 2020 and no substantive 2025/2026 update to the generic legal content was verified.
